sources.title: Skild AI introduces S1, a foundation model that learns tasks from one ...
sources.snippet: What's the deal? Skild AI has introduced S1, a robotics foundation model designed to learn previously unseen tasks from a single video prompt, without task-specific fine-tuning. In an announcement shared on 25 August 2026, the company said S1 can be taught tasks lasting up to 10 minutes and can operate in real time after observing one example.
